statement.title: Statement
statement.description: One sentence naming a single verb. If it needs 'and' or 'or', split the leaf. The leaf's rules are NOT a field here: they stay in the structured extra.rules and are added with `lore rule add`.

constraint.description: The business rule that governs it; each constraint becomes a rule.

rule_precedence.title: Rule precedence
rule_precedence.description: When two rules can both fire and the outcome differs: which wins and why.

depends_on.title: Depends on
depends_on.description: Rule ids of other leaves this leaf's rules rely on.

open_questions.title: Open questions
open_questions.description: One per undecided or unconfirmed rule.

dimensions.question: Does the leaf name exactly one verb, or is it two leaves joined?
Which two rules of this leaf can fire together with different outcomes, and which wins?
